title: What's behind today's wildest biotech moves? SELLAS jumped 143% onPhase 3 data, while Omeros fell 19%.
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Biotech handed out a jackpot and a few busts today. SELLAS more than  
doubled, up about 143% on its Phase 3 REGAL readout, while Omeros fell  
almost 19% and Iambic 11% after earnings. Regeneron and Sanofi are up  
20% and 19% in a month, and the average analyst target on Arvinas sits  
106% above the price. Today's overview of the wildest biotech moves is  
below — which name are you watching?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. SELLAS Life Sciences Group (SLS)\*\* — Shares jumped +142.57% to  
$18.12 from Monday's $7.47 close, with the advance occurring during  
Tuesday's regular session after premarket quotes ran even higher. The  
trigger was the topline Phase 3 REGAL readout: galinpepimut-S (GPS)  
met its primary overall survival endpoint in acute myeloid leukemia  
patients in second complete remission, a result the company called  
pivotal.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sellas-life-sciences-group-sls-stock-up-164-12-today-39823/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sellas-life-sciences-group-sls-stock-up-164-12-today-39823/)  
  
\*\*2. Omeros (OMER)\*\* — OMER dropped -18.76%, from Monday's $16.68  
close to $13.55 in early Tuesday regular-session trading, extending a  
roughly -10% after-hours slide that began with Monday's post-close  
report. Third-quarter net YARTEMLEA product revenue of $35.9 million  
missed the \~$37.3 million consensus, and the gross-to-net discount  
widened to 14% from 11.5%, with management guiding that figure toward  
the high teens.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-omeros-corporation-omer-stock-down-19-84-today-39751/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-omeros-corporation-omer-stock-down-19-84-today-39751/)  
  
\*\*3. Iambic Therapeutics (IAM)\*\* — IAM dropped from a $13.10 close to  
$11.60, a -11.45% move, during the regular session after the release  
landed before the opening bell. The catalyst was the first quarterly  
report since the October IPO: the net loss widened to $38.5 million  
(-$8.52 a share) from $21.5 million a year earlier, operating expenses  
jumped +52% to $41.5 million including a $10.4 million non-cash  
convertible-note charge, and...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-iambic-therapeutics-iam-stock-down-11-45-today-39834/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-iambic-therapeutics-iam-stock-down-11-45-today-39834/)  
  
\*\*4. Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN)\*\* — Regeneron Pharmaceuticals  
(REGN) rose roughly 20% over the past 30 days, from an adjusted close  
of about $790.74 on October 16, 2026, to about $952.40 on November 16,  
2026.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/regeneron-pharmaceuticals-regn-climbs-20-on-strong-q3-results-39442/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/regeneron-pharmaceuticals-regn-climbs-20-on-strong-q3-results-39442/)  
  
\*\*5. Sanofi (SNY)\*\* — Sanofi (SNY) shares have climbed roughly 19%  
over the past 30 days, rising from about $40.61 to near $48.39 on the  
strength of a better-than-expected third-quarter earnings report.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/sanofi-sny-shares-rise-19-on-q3-earnings-beat-and-raised-2026-guidance-39441/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/sanofi-sny-shares-rise-19-on-q3-earnings-beat-and-raised-2026-guidance-39441/)  
  
\*\*6. Arvinas (ARVN)\*\* — The central price target used here is $14 ,  
the arithmetic mean of nine current, individually attributed analyst  
targets issued between August and November 2026, rounded from roughly  
$13.80. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/arvinas-arvn-and-the-14-price-target-is-106-upside-realistic-39505/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/arvinas-arvn-and-the-14-price-target-is-106-upside-realistic-39505/)  
  
\*\*7. Keros Therapeutics (KROS)\*\* — KROS jumped +7.28% to $10.76 from  
Monday's $10.03 close, with the gain recorded during regular-session  
trading on Nov. 17. The catalyst came after Monday's close: the board  
approved an additional $5 million share repurchase authorization  
following receipt of a $20 million development milestone from partner  
Takeda, and an 8-K showed the combined effect extends the cash runway  
into 2029 from H2 2028.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-keros-therapeutics-kros-stock-up-6-58-today-39860/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-keros-therapeutics-kros-stock-up-6-58-today-39860/)  
  
\*\*8. Kura Oncology (KURA)\*\* — KURA jumped to about $7.56 from the  
prior close of $7.09, a +6.63% gain, in the first hour of  
regular-session trading on Nov 17 after climbing as high as roughly  
$7.86. No verified news or fundamental catalyst found; the only  
company-specific item was a scheduled UBS biopharma conference  
appearance, which is routine, so the move is likely a technical  
rebound from deeply oversold levels after the -22.98%...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-kura-oncology-kura-stock-up-6-49-today-39830/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-kura-oncology-kura-stock-up-6-49-today-39830/)  
  
\*\*9. Lycia Therapeutics (LYCA)\*\* — Lycia Therapeutics jumped +5.91% in  
Tuesday's regular session, climbing from Monday's $28.61 close to  
$30.30 within the first half hour after the 9:30 a.m. ET open. The  
catalyst was a cluster of post-IPO-quiet-period initiations published  
before the open: Guggenheim Buy/$75, Jefferies Buy/$50, Evercore ISI  
Outperform/$43 and TD Cowen Buy.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-lycia-therapeutics-lyca-stock-up-5-91-today-39822/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-lycia-therapeutics-lyca-stock-up-5-91-today-39822/)  
  
\*\*10. ImmunityBio (IBRX)\*\* — ImmunityBio shares jumped +4.18%, rising  
from the prior close of $5.98 to $6.23 in regular-session trading on  
Tuesday, reversing part of a six-session losing streak. No verified  
news or fundamental catalyst found for the move; no company release,  
SEC filing, or analyst action has been published since Monday's  
conference transcripts.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-immunitybio-ibrx-stock-up-4-18-today-39807/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-immunitybio-ibrx-stock-up-4-18-today-39807/)  
  
\*\*11. AZN vs MRK\*\* — Weighing Diversification Against Momentum. Two  
setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out ahead? The breakdown is  
in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/astrazeneca-azn-vs-merck-mrk-weighing-diversification-against-momentum-39741/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/astrazeneca-azn-vs-merck-mrk-weighing-diversification-against-momentum-39741/)  
  
\*\*12. DNA vs RXRX\*\* — Weighing Two AI-Focused Biotech Names. Two  
setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out ahead? The breakdown is  
in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/dna-vs-rxrx-weighing-two-ai-focused-biotech-names-39726/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/dna-vs-rxrx-weighing-two-ai-focused-biotech-names-39726/)  
  
\*\*13. BSX vs SYK\*\* — Boston Scientific Down -53% YTD While Stryker  
Falls Just -11%. Two setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out  
ahead? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/bsx-vs-syk-boston-scientific-down-53-ytd-while-stryker-falls-just-11-39554/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/bsx-vs-syk-boston-scientific-down-53-ytd-while-stryker-falls-just-11-39554/)  
  
\*\*14. Edwards Lifesciences (EW)\*\* — Edwards Lifesciences (EW) shares  
gained roughly 23.7% over the last 30 days, climbing from a close near  
$86.60 in mid-October to about $107.11.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/edwards-lifesciences-ew-23-7-climb-in-30-days-earnings-beat-and-growth-momentum-39439/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/edwards-lifesciences-ew-23-7-climb-in-30-days-earnings-beat-and-growth-momentum-39439/)  
  
Which biotech name are you watching after today's swings, and why?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
